content.title: Sean Penn Wins Best Supporting Actor at Oscars 2026—But Doesn’t Go to the Ceremony
content.text: Skip to main contentMenuMenuOSCARS 2026After a competitive race, Penn’s performance as the twisted, maniacal Colonel Lockjaw in Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another emerged victorious, earning the actor his third Academy Award.March 15, 2026© Warner Bros/Everett Collection.It’s one win after another (after another) for Sean Penn. The One Battle After Another star is now a three-time Oscar winner, taking home best supporting actor for his go-for-broke performance as creepy, corrupt would-be Christmas Adventurer Colonel Steven J. Lockjaw in Paul Thomas Anderson’s best-picture nominee.Keep ReadingContinue reading with a Vanity Fair subscription and get unlimited access, exclusive newsletters, and more.
